Pathogen.title: Pathogen

description:
Input for get_respiratory_snapshot.

Returns the latest week's levels across all three signals for the requested
pathogens in a single jurisdiction.

jurisdiction.description: US state code (e.g. 'GA'), territory (e.g. 'PR'), or 'USA'/'national'. Case-insensitive; common aliases accepted.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

pathogens.description: List of pathogens to include. Defaults to all three ('influenza', 'covid19', 'rsv').
pathogens.title: Pathogens

as_of.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) to restrict analysis to data on or before this date. Omit to use the most recent available data. Useful for reproducible demos and evaluation.
as_of.title: As Of
